concerns.text: Task T014 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but its description explicitly requires the sequential execution of T008 → T009 → T010 → T011 → T012 → T013. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer risk if run in parallel, violating the foundational‑tasks‑first ordering principle.

Task T015 is marked `[P]` yet depends on the successful completion of all prior tasks (model training, evaluation, reports). Parallel execution could precede required artifacts, breaking the data‑flow ordering.

Task T016 is also tagged `[P]` while it requires the existence of artifacts produced in earlier phases (e.g., model outputs, evaluation reports). The `[P]` tag is therefore inaccurate and may lead to unsafe parallel scheduling.
